materialx_cache.prior_behavior: Memory entries used only the document path and disk bakes only the root modification time. Included image directories were lost. Direct shader-node connections were omitted by the baker, shader versions were dropped, and partial/corrupt outputs could be reused.
materialx_cache.implementation: Fingerprint the root, recursive includes, resolved images and authored GLSL source dependencies; preserve source origins and library defaults. Publish validated generated documents and images under a content key with a writer lock and a verified artifact manifest. Do not cache failed, incomplete or concurrently changed inputs.
materialx_cache.remaining: Installed MaterialX libraries are treated as immutable within a process. Unresolved frame/UDIM substitution and the remaining shader, geometry graph and baking/filtering fidelity gates still apply.

gltf_material_extension_textures.prior_behavior: Only five core texture inputs were imported; extension textures were ignored and iridescence thickness was hardcoded to 400 nm. A base normal texture could replace authored tangents when its UVs were transformed.
gltf_material_extension_textures.implementation: All twelve texture inputs retain channels, transfer functions, UV selection/transforms and samplers. A float RGBA atlas preserves independent dimensions and mip chains; a vertex texture carries extension UVs. Iridescence thickness ranges, coat-normal scales and authored tangents reach shading.
gltf_material_extension_textures.render_controls: Factor equivalence under directional, ambient and dome lighting; each map with transformed UVs; complete core/extension stack; normal vectors against authored tangent frames.
gltf_material_extension_textures.filter_controls: Independent float64 texel/mip references for RGBA maps; 3e-5 tolerance, with periodic, mirrored, clamped and constant-border axes and all six min/two mag filters.
gltf_material_extension_textures.remaining: Camera/light/application-specific animation pointers, MikkTSpace equivalence, transmitted-shadow variation and independent BRDF verification remain open. Node/material pointers and KTX2/BasisU inputs have regression evidence. This is not full glTF or schema conformance.

gltf_animation_pointers.prior_behavior: Channels without a target node were skipped, including material and node KHR_animation_pointer channels.
gltf_animation_pointers.implementation: Typed node TRS, whole/individual morph weights, matrix translation, core/extension material factors and offset/rotation/scale for all 17 texture inputs. Clip-local bounded samples retain original images and derived material settings; object instance clocks drive material animation.
gltf_animation_pointers.validation: Undefined parents, immutable or malformed pointers, overlapping targets, invalid key times and incompatible output shapes are rejected. Normalized accessor conversion precedes interpolation.
gltf_animation_pointers.render_controls: Each of 17 texture transforms compared with independent static controls, separate playback clocks, negative speeds, loops, backward seeks, and animated opacity-mask color/shadow depth.
gltf_animation_pointers.cache_regression: Texture-transform samples reuse material/time cache entries; backward hits and eviction are checked for all 51 map/transform combinations. A loop-variable shadowing defect found during review was repaired before the final frozen-source runs.
gltf_animation_pointers.remaining: Camera, light and application-specific targets are warned and not consumed by the mesh renderer; their key times still determine clip duration. Full glTF conformance is not established.

gltf_basisu_textures.prior_behavior: The reader did not select KHR_texture_basisu image sources. Required textures without a fallback were skipped, and ordinary texture storage discarded authored mip levels.
gltf_basisu_textures.implementation: Public libktx 4 C API decodes ETC1S/BasisLZ and UASTC with optional Zstandard to RGBA8. KTX2 sources take precedence over fallbacks and retain image identity, mip levels, typed channels, color transfer and alpha. ETC1S green-in-alpha packing is restored. Every glTF material map, ordinary GPU upload and scalar/RGBA atlas retains authored mips; only a missing tail is generated in linear space. Input errors are explicit, and missing optional decoders may use a fallback.

native_runtime.dependency: External native libktx, documented in docs/RUNTIME.md. SCENERENDER_LIBKTX override, virtual-environment and system discovery. No Python binding dependency.

compatibility_controls: Legacy UASTC RRRG channel descriptor (outside current KHR channel declarations).
Two-level partial pyramid (4.4.2 validator requires one/full; current extension recommends full and describes missing-mip generation).

gltf_basisu_textures.controls: CLI-decoded pixels plus original synthetic channel checks, external/data/GLB sources, fallback precedence and missing-library errors, malformed metadata and compressed-input recovery, all 17 material slots, independent authored-mip filtering, partial pyramids, animation/backward seeks, alpha color/shadow controls and GPU cache eviction.
gltf_basisu_textures.remaining: Camera/light/application-specific animation pointers, MikkTSpace equivalence, transmitted-shadow variation and independent BRDF verification remain open. Node/material pointers and KTX2/BasisU inputs have regression evidence. This is not full glTF or schema conformance. The libktx runtime and GL integration were verified on Linux/Intel; no Windows/macOS runtime result or new GL software-renderer run is claimed.

gltf_animation_pointer_targets.behavior: Explicit warning; channel duration preserved; no imported camera/light rendering.

change.change: Replace Python 3.11-only hashlib.file_digest with chunked SHA-256 to retain Python >=3.10 compatibility.

post_full_run_verification.description: Only the SHA-256 streaming helper changed after the full run started. The full cache suite was rerun after that Python 3.10 compatibility correction. These 26 checks are included in the suite total, not added to it.
